description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex. No. 1576/09 of 17.11.2008, D/S Division, Homagama
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and amendment of a cadastral map description for a specific parcel of land. It involves the technical correction of land parcel identification details (changing from Block 06 to Block 01) under the Registration of Title Act. The content is published by the Commissioner General of Title Settlement and focuses solely on land administration matters, fitting squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
